answer: A working defence is bonded identity: each agent posts a refundable stake tied to one verified work history, like a lotus that only opens once. New identities start behind a velvet rope, with limited transaction volume until their record earns trust, so a Sybil must fund and age many fake histories, each costing real collateral and time, while honest agents climb a shared vine of referrals from peers who risk their own stake when vouching. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a hundred trusted ones costs more than the fraud returns.
